candidate.title: MiR-CLIP
candidate.scope: The single, unbranched Illumina microRNA crosslinking and immunoprecipitation (miR-CLIP) schematic: a psoralen/biotin-modified miRNA capture probe, association with target RNA-protein material, UV treatment at 254 nm and 365 nm, Ago2 immunoprecipitation, RNA extraction, streptavidin-biotin isolation and reverse transcription to cDNA. The leftmost title icon summarizes the assay and the probe icon is a component legend; neither is a separate branch. The supplied Imig et al. abstract establishes the matching modified-pre-miRNA implementation at schematic scope. The diagram stops at cDNA; subsequent library preparation and sequencing are described only at catalogue/abstract level. Listed TruSeq kits and related publications do not add target methods. No complete experimental implementation or historical priority is asserted.

states.label: miR-CLIP capture probe
features: Synthetic pre-miRNA modified with psoralen and biotin; the diagram legend separately identifies both modifications.
Biotin supplies the affinity handle; psoralen supplies the photoreactive component. Exact attachment sites, linkers and nucleotide end groups are not specified by the schematic.
